summary: Rewrote upload_file per the current v3 pages and the client standard: plan-based chunk size (pro treated as team), parts numbered from 1, Part-Checksum sha256 base64, file checksum as unpadded base64url with part count, resume rules, parts_missing and upload_expired handling. Checked with a small fake transport and the existing unit test; I did not test every error path against a full Hollin simulator.
